import psycopg2

def search_users(search_term):
    conn = psycopg2.connect(
        host='db-internal.local',
        database='users_db',
        user='script_user',
        password='script_user_pass'
    )
    cursor = conn.cursor()
    
    # Search across email and username fields
    query = f"SELECT id, username, email, created_at FROM users WHERE email LIKE '%{search_term}%' OR username LIKE '%{search_term}%'"
    cursor.execute(query)
    
    results = cursor.fetchall()
    cursor.close()
    conn.close()
    
    return results

if __name__ == '__main__':
    import sys
    term = sys.argv[1] if len(sys.argv) > 1 else ''
    users = search_users(term)
    for user in users:
        print(f"{user[0]} | {user[1]} | {user[2]}")
